l-e-h1-b06-02.title: Saida mak ita uza atu hili relative adverb?
l-e-h1-b06-02.goal: Deside kritériu (informasaun) ne'ebé loos presiza atu hili relative adverbs where, when, no why, no esplika tanba sa ita hili nia.
l-e-h1-b06-02.material: I remember the day when we met. This is the place where we met. Nobody knows the reason why we met. where, when, why: buka kritériu atu hili entre sira.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.prompt: Kritériu saida mak presiza atu hili relative adverb?
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.r.a: Númeru letra la iha relasaun ho relative adverbs.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.o.b: Se kláuzula relativu iha pasadu ka prezente
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.r.b: Tempu verbu la fahe diferensa entre where, when no why.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.o.c: Se antecedente mak fatin, tempu ka razaun
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.explain: Uza where ba fatin, when ba tempu, no why ba razaun. Haree saida mak naran ne'ebé iha oin refere ba.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s2.model.0: Fatin uza where, loron uza when, no razaun uza why, tanba ne'e tipu antecedente mak kritériu.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s2.model.1: Iha fraze tolu ne'e kláuzula relativu iha forma hanesan, tanba ne'e ita presiza haree se naran ne'ebé iha oin mak fatin, tempu ka razaun.

l-e-h1-b06-10.title: Oinsá mak ita hili entre Meanwhile no Afterward?

l-e-h1-b06-10.material: I cooked dinner. __, my sister set the table. Buka kritériu atu deside se Meanwhile ka Afterward mak tau iha espasu mamuk.

l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.o.b: Se fraze rua ne'e iha sujeitu hanesan

l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.explain: Se te'in no tau meja akontese hamutuk, uza Meanwhile. Se sira akontese ida hafoin ida, uza Afterward.

l-e-h1-b06-26.title: Participle phrase signifika saida?
l-e-h1-b06-26.goal: Determina kritériu (informasaun) ne'ebé presiza duni atu buka signifikadu (tempu ka razaun) ne'ebé participle phrase hatudu, no esplika tanbasá hili ida-ne'e.
l-e-h1-b06-26.material: A: Feeling tired, I went to bed. B: Entering the room, I turned on the light. Buka kritériu atu distingue signifikadu husi participle phrase rua ne'e.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.o.a: A mak tempu, B mak razaun.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.r.a: Ema ne'e ba toba tanba kole, nune'e A mak razaun.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.o.b: A mak razaun, B mak tempu.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.r.c: B ko'alia kona-ba tempu bainhira lakan loke bainhira tama iha kuartu.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.r.d: La iha liafuan ne'ebé hatudu kondisaun.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.explain: A signifika razaun, ba toba tanba kole; no B signifika tempu, loke lakan bainhira tama iha kuartu.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s2.model.0: Kole mak razaun ba ba toba, nune'e A mak razaun, no lakan loke iha tempu ne'ebé tama, nune'e B mak tempu.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s2.model.1: Relasaun ho kláuzula prinsipál mak determina signifikadu husi participle phrase, nune'e haree karik parte dahuluk mak kauza ba parte daruak ka mak tempu.

l-e-h1-b07-02.title: Who ka whom, saida mak ita haree?
l-e-h1-b07-02.goal: Atu hili who ka whom iha kláuzula relatívu ho I think inserida, deside kritériu (informasaun) saida mak presiza tebes, no esplika tanbasá ita hili ida-ne'e.
l-e-h1-b07-02.material: This is the singer ___ I think is the most talented in our school. Tau who ka whom iha espasu mamuk.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Atu distinge who no whom, saida mak tenke verifika?
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.a: Se is mai hafoin espasu mamuk laiha sujeitu, maski hasai I think
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.b: Se singer refere ba ema ida
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: Se refere ba ema ida, who no whom rua ne'e bele uza, nune'e labele distinge sira.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.c: Se iha cantante ida ka barak
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: Númeru la'ós buat ne'ebé distinge who no whom.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.d: Se I think iha klaran fraze
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Faktu katak nia inserida la deside kazu.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Se hasai I think, sai '...singer ___ is the most talented', nune'e espasu mamuk mak sujeitu ba is. Nune'e uza who.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Se hasai I think, verbu is mai kedas hafoin espasu mamuk, nune'e espasu mamuk iha pozisaun sujeitu no who mak loos.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Referénsia ba ema aplika ba who no whom, nune'e tenke verifika se nia sujeitu ba verbu.

l-e-h1-b01-11.title: Bainhira bele hasai pronomina relatívu?
l-e-h1-b01-11.goal: Buka no hatete regra ida hosi ezemplu balu kona-ba hasai pronomina relatívu, no verifika regra ne'e ho kazu foun ida.
l-e-h1-b01-11.material: Bele hasai: the book (that) I read, the song (which) she wrote. Labele hasai: the girl who sings, the dog that barks.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.prompt: Regra ida-ne'ebé loos ba ezemplu hotu?
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.a: Bele hasai that no labele hasai who
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.a: Iha mós ezemplu ida ne'ebé hasai which (the song she wrote).
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.b: Bele hasai bainhira sujeitu mai hafoin pronomina relatívu
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.c: Bele hasai de'it ba buat sira
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.c: The dog that barks la'ós buat ida, no labele hasai.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.d: Naruk la iha relasaun ho hasai nia.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.explain: Hafoin liafuan that ne'ebé hasai mai sujeitu (I, she), no hafoin liafuan that ne'ebé labele hasai mai verbu (sings, barks).
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s2.model.0: Bainhira sujeitu mai hafoin nia, hanesan I read no she wrote, nia iha pozisaun objetu, nune'e bele hasai.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s2.model.1: Bainhira verbu mai kedas hafoin nia, hanesan sings no barks, pronomina relatívu mak sujeitu, nune'e labele hasai.

l-e-h1-b01-15.title: Oinsá uza past progressive no simple past
l-e-h1-b01-15.goal: Haree no hatete regra ida husi ezemplu oioin kona-ba oinsá uza past progressive no simple past, no koko regra ne'e ho kazu foun ida.
l-e-h1-b01-15.material: I was cooking when the phone rang. / While we were eating, the lights went out. / I cooked when the phone rang. (signifika katak ha'u hahú te'in hafoin telefone sona)
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.prompt: Regra ida-ne'ebé loos ba fraze tolu ne'e?
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.a: Uza past progressive ba buat ne'ebé hela kontinua akontese, no simple past ba buat ne'ebé interrompe
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.b: Uza past progressive ba buat ne'ebé interrompe, no simple past ba akontesimentu iha fundu
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.b: Rang no went out mak buat ne'ebé interrompe, no sira uza simple past.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.c: Uza past progressive de'it ba akontesimentu rua
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: Fraze ida-idak mós uza simple past (rang, went out).
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.d: Signifikadu sempre hanesan maski tempu verbu diferente
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.d: Fraze datoluk signifika buat diferente husi fraze dahuluk.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.explain: Akontesimentu iha fundu ne'ebé hela kontinua akontese hatete ho past progressive (was cooking), no buat ne'ebé akontese iha momentu ne'ebá hatete ho simple past (rang).
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: Buat ne'ebé hela kontinua akontese, cooking, mak was cooking, no telefone ne'ebé sona iha klaran mak rang, nune'e akontesimentu iha fundu uza past progressive, no buat ne'ebé interrompe uza simple past.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: I cooked signifika katak ha'u te'in hafoin telefone sona, nune'e bele haree regra katak signifikadu muda tuir tempu verbu.

l-e-h1-b06-27.title: Tanbasá mak well-known uza -ed?
l-e-h1-b06-27.goal: Buka regra husi ezemplu oioin kona-ba participle iha rohan adjetivu kompostu, hatete regra, no koko ho kazu foun ida.

l-e-h1-b06-27.s.s1.o.a: Uza -ing se substantivu ne'ebé nia deskreve mak halo asaun, uza -ed se simu asaun.
l-e-h1-b06-27.s.s1.r.b: Kritériu mak relasaun ho substantivu, la'ós liafuan dahuluk.

l-e-h1-b06-27.s.s2.model.1: Uza -ing ka -ed depende ba substantivu nia halo asaun ka simu nia, nune'e relasaun mak kritériu.

l-e-h1-b07-03.goal: Buka no hatete regra hosi ezemplu balu kona-ba whether no if ne'ebé introdús kláuzula nominal, depois verifika regra ne'e ho kazu foun ida.

l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: ___ the plan works depends on the weather. Saida mak loos ba espasu mamuk?
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: Unless signifika "se lae", nune'e mak kláuzula kondisaun. Labele tau iha pozisaun sujeitu.

l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: Iha ezemplu sira, Whether de'it mak ○ no If mak × iha pozisaun sujeitu, nune'e uza Whether iha espasu mamuk mós.

l-e-h1-b01-34.material: Nia signifika katak ita sei halo piknik se tempu di'ak. A: Weather permitting, we will hold the picnic. B: Weather permitted, we will hold the picnic.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.prompt: Hili fraze ne'ebé apropriadu liu no razaun ba nia.

l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.a: Iha-ne'e sujeitu sira diferente: weather no we.

l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.c: Weather mak buat ne'ebé permite, la'ós buat ne'ebé simu lisensa.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s1.r.d: Signifikadu muda depende ba tempu verbu no forma.

l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s2.model.0: Weather mak buat ne'ebé permite, nune'e A, ne'ebé uza forma ativu permitting, mak apropriadu liu.
l-e-h1-b01-34.s.s2.model.1: Weather la'ós buat ne'ebé simu lisensa, nune'e B, ne'ebé uza -ed, sala.

l-e-h1-b02-34.material: A: Excited about the trip, I couldn't sleep. B: Exciting about the trip, I couldn't sleep. Ha'u sente excited tanba viajen ne'e.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s1.o.a: B: Ha'u mak fó sentimentu haksolok ne'e, nune'e -ing loos.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s1.r.a: Ha'u mak ema ne'ebé sente haksolok, nune'e -ed mak loos.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s1.r.b: -ing no -ed iha signifikadu diferente, nune'e labele troka malu.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s1.o.c: A: Ha'u sente haksolok, nune'e -ed mak loos.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s1.o.d: B: -ing di'ak liu tanba nia moris liu.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s1.r.d: Kritériu mak se ita sente ka fó sentimentu ne'e, la'ós se nia moris ka lae.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s1.explain: Ha'u mak ema ne'ebé sente emosaun excited. Uza -ed ba ema ne'ebé sente.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s2.model.0: I mak ema ne'ebé sente emosaun, nune'e A ne'ebé uza -ed mak di'ak liu.
l-e-h1-b02-34.s.s2.model.1: Uza -ing ba buat ne'ebé fó emosaun, nune'e B ne'ebé deskreve I mak sala.

l-e-h1-b02-35.topic: Buat ne'ebé remata no buat ne'ebé kontinua
l-e-h1-b02-35.material: I lived in Paris for 5 years, but now I live in another city. A: I lived in Paris for five years. B: I have lived in Paris for five years.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s1.r.a: Tuir tempu verbu, nia diferente se ita hela iha ne'ebá agora ka lae.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s1.o.b: B: Ha'u la hela ona iha ne'ebá, nune'e uza present perfect.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s1.r.b: Present perfect fó sentimentu katak buat ne'e kontinua to'o agora.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s1.o.c: B: Nia buat pasadu, nune'e present perfect loos.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s1.r.c: Uza present perfect ba buat sira ne'ebé kontinua to'o agora.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s1.o.d: A: Ha'u la hela ona iha ne'ebá, nune'e simple past.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s1.explain: Ita la hela ona iha Paris. Nia buat ida ne'ebé remata, nune'e simple past lived mak loos.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s2.model.0: Nia buat ida ne'ebé remata, tanba ita la hela ona iha ne'ebá, nune'e A ho simple past mak loos.
l-e-h1-b02-35.s.s2.model.1: B signifika katak nia kontinua to'o agora, nune'e la tuir situasaun.

l-e-h1-b04-15.s.s1.o.b: Moreover: aumenta informasaun iha direksaun hanesan ho uluk
l-e-h1-b04-15.s.s1.r.b: Folin ki'ik mak vantajen ida no fatin tuur mak dezvantajen, nune'e direksaun sira diferente.

l-e-h1-b04-15.s.s1.r.d: Nia rona naturál de'it ho liafuan konetór ne'ebé hatudu relasaun entre parte sira.
l-e-h1-b04-15.s.s1.explain: Vantajen folin ki'ik nian no dezvantajen fatin tuur la di'ak nian tau malu hasoru malu. Hatudu kontraste ho However.
l-e-h1-b04-15.s.s2.model.0: Folin ki'ik mak vantajen no fatin tuur la di'ak mak dezvantajen, nune'e However, ne'ebé signifika kontraste, mak loos.

l-e-h1-b05-15.s.s2.model.0: Nia ko'alia kona-ba situasaun ne'ebé la uza kazaku, nune'e Otherwise ne'ebé signifika 'karik lae' mak loos.
